title: Give One Recurring Task a Home
teaser: A reliable home for repeated work reduces searching and restarting.
full_text: Choose one task you repeat often and decide where its files, notes and next steps will always live. Move today's materials there before you finish.

title: Check the Assumption Behind a Deadline
teaser: A deadline can look fixed even when the reason behind it has changed.
full_text: Take one upcoming deadline and identify what actually depends on it. Confirm whether the date is externally fixed, internally chosen or simply inherited.

title: Use One Number to Define Better
teaser: Improvement is easier to discuss when better has an observable meaning.
full_text: Pick one area you want to improve and choose a single useful measure. Record today's baseline before deciding on a target.

title: Reduce the Distance to a Useful Habit
teaser: A helpful behavior is easier to repeat when the needed tools are already within reach.
full_text: Choose one habit you want to make easier. Prepare the object, document or environment so the first step requires less setup tomorrow.

title: Ask What Would Change Your Mind
teaser: A position becomes more useful when you know what evidence could revise it.
full_text: For one opinion or decision you feel strongly about, write the kind of new evidence that would make you reconsider. If nothing could, notice that too.

title: Separate Urgent From Merely Loud
teaser: Visibility and interruption can make a task feel more important than it is.
full_text: Review today's incoming requests. Identify which one has a real consequence for delay and which one is simply demanding attention.

title: Turn a Complaint Into a Specific Request
teaser: Problems become easier to address when the desired change is clear.
full_text: Take one frustration you have repeated recently. Rewrite it as a concrete request describing what you want to happen differently.

title: Audit One Automatic Renewal
teaser: Recurring charges can continue long after their value has changed.
full_text: Review one subscription or automatic payment today. Compare recent use with its cost and decide to keep, change or cancel it deliberately.

title: Leave Margin Between Two Commitments
teaser: Back-to-back plans assume every earlier task will end exactly on time.
full_text: Add a small buffer between two commitments this week. Use the space for transition rather than immediately filling it with another task.

title: Write the Decision Owner Down
teaser: A group can discuss a choice for a long time when nobody knows who decides.
full_text: For one shared decision, name who provides input and who makes the final call. Put that distinction in writing before the next discussion.

title: Test a Memory Against the Record
teaser: Confidence in recall does not guarantee accuracy.
full_text: Choose one recent event you remember clearly and compare it with a calendar, message, receipt or note. Notice which details memory changed or omitted.

title: Protect One Uninterrupted Work Window
teaser: Important work often loses quality through repeated context switching.
full_text: Reserve one short block today for a single task. Close optional tabs and alerts before starting, then measure whether you finished more cleanly.

title: Make a Favor Easy to Decline
teaser: A request is healthier when the other person can say no without penalty.
full_text: When asking for help today, state the request clearly and leave room for a genuine refusal. Avoid language that turns consent into obligation.

title: Review the Maintenance Cost of a Choice
teaser: Some purchases and projects keep consuming resources after the initial decision.
full_text: Pick one thing you own or manage. Estimate the ongoing time, money and attention it requires, not only the cost of acquiring it.

title: Choose a Stop Time Before You Start
teaser: A defined stopping point can prevent small tasks from expanding without limit.
full_text: Before beginning one flexible task today, choose when you will stop or what output will be enough. Reassess only if new evidence justifies more time.

title: Notice Which Question You Keep Avoiding
teaser: Repeated avoidance can signal an unresolved decision rather than a lack of information.
full_text: Write one question you keep postponing. Identify whether you need more evidence, a conversation or simply a decision date.

title: Check a Process From the User's Side
teaser: A process can look efficient internally while creating friction for the person using it.
full_text: Walk through one form, instruction or workflow as if you were seeing it for the first time. Record the first point that feels unclear or unnecessary.

title: Replace a Vague Reminder With a Trigger
teaser: Remember later is weaker than connecting an action to a clear event.
full_text: Take one reminder you keep missing and attach it to a specific trigger such as arriving home, finishing lunch or opening a particular file.

title: Keep One Meeting Note Actionable
teaser: Meeting notes lose value when decisions and owners disappear inside paragraphs.
full_text: After one conversation today, capture decisions, owners and next dates separately from general notes. Make the next action visible at a glance.

title: Compare the Cheapest Option With the Total Cost
teaser: A lower purchase price can hide higher costs of time, repair or replacement.
full_text: For one choice you are evaluating, compare total expected cost rather than sticker price alone. Include maintenance, travel, fees or replacement if relevant.

title: Give Feedback Close to the Event
teaser: Specific feedback becomes harder when details fade.
full_text: If something went notably well or poorly today, give brief feedback while the event is still concrete. Describe the behavior and its effect rather than the person's character.

title: Create a Recovery Plan Before a Busy Day
teaser: Resilience is easier when recovery is scheduled rather than left to leftover time.
full_text: Look at your next demanding day and choose one realistic recovery action afterward. Protect the time before the day becomes crowded.

title: Check Whether a Rule Still Serves Its Purpose
teaser: Old rules can survive after the problem they solved has disappeared.
full_text: Choose one personal or team rule you follow automatically. Name the purpose it serves today and revise it if the purpose no longer exists.

title: Make the First Draft Deliberately Incomplete
teaser: Trying to solve every detail at once can delay useful feedback.
full_text: For one piece of work, create a rough version that answers only the central question. Use what you learn from it before investing in polish.

title: Ask for the Constraint Before Offering Advice
teaser: Advice can miss the real problem when available time, money or authority is unknown.
full_text: Before suggesting a solution today, ask what constraint matters most. Tailor your response to the limit instead of assuming unlimited options.

title: Review One Permission You No Longer Need
teaser: Old access can remain long after a device, app or collaborator no longer requires it.
full_text: Check one account, app or shared folder today. Remove an unnecessary permission if doing so does not disrupt a current responsibility.

title: End a Task With the Next Step Visible
teaser: Restarting is easier when you do not have to reconstruct where you stopped.
full_text: Before closing an unfinished task, leave a short note naming the exact next action. Make tomorrow's restart a continuation rather than a fresh investigation.

title: Close February by Choosing What Not to Carry
teaser: A monthly review can create space by ending commitments as well as adding goals.
full_text: Review February and identify one activity, assumption or obligation that no longer deserves March capacity. Decide how you will close or reduce it.
